translations.text: A generation passes away, and a generation comes, but the earth stands forever.
All streams flow into the sea, yet the sea is not filled in its place.
What has he done beyond what has been done, and what has happened beyond what has happened? There is nothing that has been done under the sun.
I made vegetable gardens and parks for myself, and planted in them every kind of tree that bears fruit in its season, and every kind that does not bear fruit.
I looked to see wisdom, folly, and madness. Who is the man who will follow after counsel, and every example he made for it? [?]
To the one who sins he gave the task of increasing and gathering wealth, so that he might give it to the good person who stands before God. This too is emptiness and a desire for wind.
A time to live and a time to die; a time to plant and a time to uproot what was planted; a time to wound and a time to heal; a time to build and a time to tear down.
A time to weep and a time to laugh; a time for amusement and a time to dance.
Look, there are tears among those who are oppressed, and there is no one to comfort them against those who oppress them by force.
If he is strong, the two will stand against him, and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
I saw all the living together, those who walk under the sun, with another young man who rises in his place.
When you make a vow, do not delay fulfilling it, for that is not his will. Rather, give what you have vowed.
Every person to whom God has given wealth and possessions, and whom he has empowered to eat from them, take his share, and rejoice in his labor—this too is God's gift.
Wisdom helps the wise person more than a thousand rulers who are in the city.
She is far from me, remaining far away and deeply, deeply hidden. Who can find her?
I turned my mind toward understanding, to consider and seek wisdom and reasoning, and to understand the folly of the wicked and the mockery of errors.

I find her more bitter than death: the woman who is a trap, whose heart is a net, and whose hands hold bonds. The person who is good before God escapes from her, but the one who sins is caught by her.
There was found within it a wise but poor man, and he saved that city by his wisdom. Yet no one at all remembered that man.
When a fool walks in the folly of his heart and follows his heart's desire, understanding fails him, and everything he thinks is foolish.
I saw slaves on horses and rulers walking on foot like slaves.
The person who moves a stone is hurt by it, and the person who splits wood is injured by it.
Send your bread out upon the surface of the water, for after many days you will find it.
On the day when the keepers of the house tremble and the strong men are shaken, the women who grind are brought low because they are weak, and those who look through the windows grow dark.
The dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it. It will give an account of everything he did to me while he lived in the flesh, whether good or evil.
Moreover, because the Preacher was wise, he taught knowledge to all the people, and examined the arrangement of proverbs.
